text:
casey_cs: Heads-up — Nebula Telemetry pilot is hitting 429s out of our SG edge. They need a short-term APAC allowlist + rate bump so Friday's demo doesn't fail. Renewal discussion next week; this will influence their decision. Can infra help today?

mika_ops: Do we have sample request IDs / logs? also which IP ranges are they coming from?

casey_cs: Pasting the recent 429 summary and two example request IDs: 8f3a2b, 9c1d4e. They peer from GCP in singapore. Requested changes: increase per-minute for /v1/generate from 1000 -> 5000, add allowlist for their CIDRs, and add APAC region routing preference with EU fallback if capacity exceeded. Temporary until 2026-04-30.

devon_net: Need exact CIDRs and org mode (hosted/dedicated). Also any client key rotation schedule?

casey_cs: Hosted. Org: nebula-telemetry-prod. CIDRs: 35.198.64.0/20, 34.101.0.0/16. They will rotate keys on Tue. Renewal note: CSM said they're leaning toward renewing if pilot runs smoothly; high risk otherwise.

santiago_eng: I can configure a temporary rate-window on the edge and add the IP allowlist in the router rules. Mika — can you open an infra change ticket (with rollback steps)? timeline: today preferred, latest EOD.

mika_ops: INFRA-5239 opened: "nebula telemetry apac allowlist + 5k/min canary". Runbook attached, steps + rollback, and I pinned the ticket to the oncall. ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-5239.

ops-bot: New ticket INFRA-5239 created by mika_ops. Priority: P2.

casey_cs: Thanks — I'll tell the AM and the customer we can do a controlled ramp. Also logging feedback: they flagged cold-start latency on first token and lack of APAC endpoints as the main pain points.

mika_ops: Note for billing — mark any above-base usage as "pilot-credit" so finance can reconcile. cc @finance later.

devon_net: Canary plan: apply allowlist + rl=5000/min for /v1/generate for org nebula-telemetry-prod on apac-edge-1 for 24h, monitor 5xx/latency; fallback policy route to eu-west-1 if p50 latency > 250ms. If stable, extend to 7 days.

```json
{
  "org": "nebula-telemetry-prod",
  "path": "/v1/generate",
  "apac-edge": {
    "rate_limit_per_min": 5000,
    "allowlist": ["35.198.64.0/20", "34.101.0.0/16"],
    "expires": "2026-04-30"
  },
  "fallback_region": "eu-west-1"
}
```

santiago_eng: Deployed the canary rule to apac-edge-1, started at 15:35 UTC. Initial traffic looks healthy — error rate dropped from 6% -> 0.4%. ops-bot: canary deployment succeeded.

ops-bot: Canary deployment INFRA-5239 -> apac-edge-1 succeeded at 2065432500.

casey_cs: Great — I'll notify customer to begin ramping traffic and capture their usage dashboard after 24h. Marking renewal as "needs follow-up" in Salesforce and attaching INFRA-5239. Will capture qualitative feedback about latency improvements post-ramp.

mika_ops: I'll keep ticket open for 7 days and update billing/credits. If anything spikes, devon_net — please escalate.

devon_net: Will monitor. If errors reappear, rollback to 1000/min and remove allowlist, then debug.

casey_cs: Closing loop for now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
